scene: The comics reveal transit maps across town.
picture: Flat pixel side view. On the far left waits a red pedicab rickshaw. Centre-left, the elderly player in flat cap and orange cardigan holds his cane, examining an open city comic map. To his right, an arched gate reveals a docked yellow water taxi. On the far right, an angled funicular car rests on steep tracks.
shown: a wheeled rickshaw waiting by a sign on the far left
a yellow water taxi docked at a canal gate on the right
a glass funicular car on rails waiting on the far right
